sentences.text: Present: Mr. Ashok K. Tyagi, Advocate, for the petitioner.
Mr. Raj Kumar Negi, Additional Advocate General, for the respondent.
Mr. Raj Kumar Negi, learned Additional Advocate General, appears and waives service of notice on behalf of the respondent and seeks time to file status report.
Be filed well before the next date of hearing.

The petitioner/accused apprehends her arrest in a case registered against her vide FIR No. 55 of 2024 dated 06.05.2024, under Section 376 of Indian Penal Code and Section 6 of POCSO Act and Sections 9 & 10 of Prohibition of Child Marriage Act registered at Police Station Janjehli, District Mandi, H.P.

sentences.text: In view of the averments made in the application and also the averments made by learned counsel for the petitioner/accused, it is directed that in the event of arrest of the petitioner/accused in this case, she shall be released on bail subject to her furnishing personal bond in the sum of Rs.25,000/- with one surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of Arresting Police Officer/Investigating Officer.
She, however, is directed to report to the Investigating Officer for the purpose of interrogation on 18.05.2024 at 11.00 A.M. and thereafter also as and when called upon to do so.
